The club was founded in 1909. Its colours are black and white. In its history, Sturm Graz has won the Austrian football championship five times, in 1998, 1999, 2011, 2024 and 2025, and participated several times in the [[UEFA Champions League]] and [[UEFA Europa League]]. Their biggest rivals are Graz neighbours [[Grazer AK]], with whom they share their stadium, the [[Liebenauer Stadium|Merkur Arena]]."}}
